verdict.rationale: Bulk actions on many mail items at once (scanning, shredding, forwarding, labeling) are a fair question for a virtual mailbox service, but the evidence never documents any multi-select or batch capability. The generic API (docs-11) is only a developer building block, and automatic AI labels and junk filtering (docs-4, docs-6) are adjacent per-item automation, not user-initiated bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
